investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Tapwave Press (news and media publishing); Platform: AWS ap-south-1 (zones ap-south-1a/ap-south-1b/ap-south-1c); network range 10.107.0.0/16; Database: mysql server content-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-0cd13ed5c986b645b; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
